scope: Opt-in Wrapper-Vapor (experimental) graphics driver carrying the full local wrapper patch stack.

library.unstripped_reproduces: byte-identical to the qualified full-stack build
library.strip: llvm-strip (no flags); --strip-unneeded and -x produce different bytes
library.qualification: the binary every probe family ran on 4 KB and 16 KB software-Vulkan emulators (docs/evidence/2026-10-22-vulkan-wrapper-patch-stack.json, render-stack, validation)

package.layout: stock wrapper.tzst members and metadata; only usr/lib/libvulkan_wrapper.so replaced (fixed mtime 2026-10-22T00:00:00Z)
package.hooks: stock adrenotools/hook libraries, the set this build was linked against and qualified with (libadrenotools 7412c757...); Leegao package hooks differ and are not used
package.generator: tools/vulkan-wrapper/package-wrapper-vapor.py (refuses any library but the qualified hash; output reproduced byte-for-byte)

app_integration.mapping: runtime/system/WrapperVariant.kt replaces the inline id->asset/marker/hook logic in XServerDisplayActivity; existing marker strings unchanged (stock/leegao/gamenative), so existing installs do not re-extract
app_integration.automatic_graphics: not affected: AutomaticGraphics only routes containers on the default wrapper; an explicit Wrapper-Vapor choice is respected and never auto-selected

tests.device: API 36 emulator: WrapperVariantDeviceTest 3/3 (all four packages extract via TarCompressorUtils; Vapor library hash and stock hooks verified; settings entries map 1:1 to packages), GameMenuUiTest 7, GraphicsDriverProbeDeviceTest 5, DriversScreenTest 1, ComponentsScreenTest 2, GameSettingsNavigationTest 2 = 20/20

limitations: Not run on an Adreno/KGSL phone; software Vulkan only.
No full game launch with this driver on the emulator (requires the prepared runtime); the binary itself is the probe-qualified build.
Device-teardown leaves 2 constants VkDeviceMemory allocations to the driver (gfxstream crash workaround).
